As the position is located in Harsewinkel, we might take over the following:• Attractive working conditions: comprehensive remuneration and benefits package, 30 days’ annual leave, flexible working hours and flexitime arrangements, remote working and much more.• Extensive employee benefits: employee share scheme, Sportnavi, family services, staff canteen, company doctor and much more.Ergänzende Informationen:Nur schwerbehinderte oder ihnen gleichgestellte Personen
